title: ITI Placement Returns Upload
subtitle: Upload monthly placement returns for verification and DPDP 2023 compliant ingestion.

dropzone.drag_and_drop: or drag and drop your file here
dropzone.accepted_formats: Only CSV format (.csv) up to 10 MB

summary.title: Validation Summary

summary.fix_errors_prompt: Please correct the issues indicated below before uploading.

privacy.dpdp_notice: Candidate IDs are hashed before upload and never shown. Complying with the DPDP Act 2023.

errors.INVALID_FILE_TYPE: Invalid file type. Only .csv files are supported
errors.PLA_CSV_EMPTY: The uploaded placement file is empty
errors.PLA_CSV_MALFORMED_HEADER: CSV header columns do not match canonical template
errors.PLA_CSV_MAX_ROWS_EXCEEDED: Batch exceeds maximum limit of 50,000 records
errors.PLA_UNSANCTIONED_COURSE: Course code is not sanctioned for this institute
errors.PLA_OUT_OF_RANGE_BATCH_YEAR: Batch year is outside allowable academic year range
errors.PLA_INVALID_BOOLEAN_FLAG: Placement flag must be Y or N
errors.PLA_MISSING_EMPLOYER_NAME: Employer name is mandatory for placed candidates
errors.PLA_MISSING_JOB_ROLE: Job role is mandatory for placed candidates
errors.PLA_SALARY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Monthly salary must be between 8,000 and 200,000 INR
errors.PLA_INVALID_MONTHS_TO_HIRE: Months to placement must be an integer between 0 and 36

fixes.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Split placement records into smaller batches under 10 MB.
fixes.INVALID_FILE_TYPE: Save your data in standard CSV format and try again.
fixes.PLA_CSV_EMPTY: Ensure file includes the header and at least one candidate row.
fixes.PLA_CSV_MALFORMED_HEADER: Download the standard template and check column order.
fixes.PLA_CSV_MAX_ROWS_EXCEEDED: Partition the file into monthly batches under 50,000 rows.
fixes.PLA_INVALID_CANDIDATE_ID: Enter a 6-32 character alphanumeric ID or SHA-256 hash.
fixes.PLA_UNSANCTIONED_COURSE: Use an active trade course code sanctioned for your ITI.
fixes.PLA_OUT_OF_RANGE_BATCH_YEAR: Set batch year to current year or previous 2 years.
fixes.PLA_INVALID_BOOLEAN_FLAG: Enter Y for placed student or N for unplaced student.
fixes.PLA_MISSING_EMPLOYER_NAME: Enter the registered hiring enterprise name.
fixes.PLA_MISSING_JOB_ROLE: Specify the designated vocational job title.
fixes.PLA_SALARY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Enter gross monthly salary between 8,000 and 200,000.
fixes.PLA_INVALID_MONTHS_TO_HIRE: Enter number of months from completion to job offer (0-36).
